record.title: Recover the stock consumer of the acquired long key field
record.intent: Determine exact length, encoding and byte selection before building a specimen-derived guest fixture.
requirements: Commit and push tasking before execution. Use preserved files and static recovery first; no physical contact.

Follow getLicenseKey outputs through the actual option verification/install consumers. Identify exact trimming, hex decoding, length checks, buffer selection and crypto key-width behavior, including error paths.
Distinguish recovered software semantics from format guesses. A130character ASCIIhex field must not be presumed a key type or truncated unless stock code does so.
Use bounded original-instruction or disposable-guest controls only for genuine ambiguity; declare environment setup and preserve failures. Keep acquired bytes and identities private.
Report whether the prior synthetic fixture is semantically sufficient or misses a consumer branch. Commit and push before decision.
acceptance: A precise consumer contract or bounded unresolved ambiguity is documented with source addresses and evidence.
